truth: Rejected mutations are bounded negative witnesses, not operational failures or broader security evidence.

x2_operational_failures.summary: The first x2 execute-once attempt invoked the skill quick-validator under the inherited Windows default codec; all twenty validations failed before any family runner receipt was created.
The first x2 test selection ran against that partial receipt state: seventeen tests passed, two failed, and one errored; it earned zero complete-selection credit.
A direct one-skill diagnostic reproduced the CP1252 Unicode decode failure and exited nonzero before validation.
The first x2 Method Flow summarize command wrote valid summary files but its final console projection failed on Māori text under the Windows default output codec.
The combined evidence staged-review wrapper returned no display projection even though the exact PASS review and clean staged state persisted.

x2_recovery_methods.method: Pin PYTHONUTF8 and PYTHONIOENCODING to UTF-8 for the validator subprocess, retain the failed receipt, and rerun only because no skill or runner success existed.
x2_recovery_methods.trigger: A Unicode-emitting phase-local skill is validated by a script that uses the process default encoding.

x2_recovery_methods.method: Verify the persisted summary and validation files first, then pin UTF-8 only for the summary console projection.
x2_recovery_methods.trigger: A validated Method Flow summary contains Unicode text and the console uses a legacy output codec.

x2_recovery_methods.method: Inspect the persisted review, staged and unstaged counts, mismatch lists, and diff hygiene before deciding whether any rerun is necessary.
x2_recovery_methods.trigger: A bounded staged-review wrapper returns no display projection after it may have completed.
